# WOD Wiki — Complete Agent, Language & Tool Reference

> Tri-surface reference for Browser WebMCP (`navigator.modelContext`), HTTP/Stdio MCP (`/api/mcp` & `wod mcp`), and CLI (`wod --json`).

# Whiteboard Language Reference

Fence tags: ```time (optional sport suffix e.g. ```time:cardio, ```time:crossfit, ```time:climb) or ```log.

## Core Tokens & Metrics
- **Timestamps / Durations**: `20:00` (20 min countdown), `:30` (30 sec), `1:05:00` (1 hr 5 min).
- **Timers & Rounds**: `(21-15-9)` rep scheme, `5 Rounds`, `EMOM 10:00`, `Tabata`, `AMRAP 12:00`.
- **Reps & Resistance**: `21 Thrusters @95lb`, `5x5 Back Squat @80%`, `15 Kettlebell Swings @24kg`.
- **Distance**: `400m Run`, `2km Row`, `50ft Handstand Walk`.
- **Action Modifiers**: `[:Rest 1:00]`, `+Compose`.
- **Grouping / Indentation**: Indent child movements by 2 spaces beneath timer or round headers.

## Canonical Example
```time
# Fran
(21-15-9)
  Thrusters @95lb
  Pull-ups
```

## Portable Domain Tools (22 tools — WebMCP + MCP Server + CLI)

### `wod_parse_script` (Tier 0 — script)
- **Title**: Parse Whiteboard Script
- **Description**: Validate Whiteboard Script syntax, inspect parsed statements, typed metrics, unresolved choices, and collectible `?` placeholders. Defaults to dry-run (`save: false`); pass `save: true` to persist as a Note.
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod parse - --no-save --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Whiteboard Script body OR full Markdown document containing ```time / ```wod blocks."
    },
    "sport": {
      "description": "Optional sport fence dialect override (e.g. \"crossfit\", \"climbing\", \"running\").",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "save": {
      "description": "Default false (dry-run syntax & metric inspection). Set true to persist as a Note.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "noteId": {
      "description": "Optional target Note ID when save=true.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "title": {
      "description": "Optional Note title when save=true.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "notebookId": {
      "description": "Optional user Notebook slug/ID when save=true.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "source"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_query_wql` (Tier 0 — wql)
- **Title**: Execute WQL Query
- **Description**: Run any WQL find (`:note`, `:session`, `:effort`, `:equipment`, `:tag`, `:feed`, `:block`), aggregate (`sum:volume`, `max:weight`, `count:sessions`), or pipeline query against the active WOD Wiki storage.
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod query '<wql>' --format json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "WQL query expression (e.g. \":note{notebook:journal}\", \":session last 30d\", \"sum:volume by {week}\")."
    },
    "preferredUnit": {
      "description": "Optional display unit conversion preference (e.g. \"lb\", \"kg\", \"m\", \"mi\").",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "limit": {
      "description": "Maximum rows/items to return in the response payload (default 100).",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 500
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_validate_wql` (Tier 0 — wql)
- **Title**: Validate & Inspect WQL Query
- **Description**: Parse a WQL string without executing it. Returns syntax validity, query family (find, aggregate, pipeline), normalized WQL string, and the allowed filter keys and `by {}` grouping dimensions for that plane.
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod query "<wql>" --format json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "query": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "WQL query string to validate and inspect (e.g. \":note{notebook:journal} last 7d\" or \"sum:volume by {effort}\")."
    },
    "targetHint": {
      "description": "Optional target plane to list valid filter keys & grouping dimensions for (note, session, effort, equipment, tag, feed, block, event).",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "query"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_note_list` (Tier 0 — note)
- **Title**: List Notes
- **Description**: List workout and reference Notes with optional filtering by Notebook, search query, tag, and origin.
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod note list --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "notebookId": {
      "description": "Filter by notebook ID or slug (e.g. \"journal\", \"custom\", \"guides\", \"notebook/strength\").",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "search": {
      "description": "Case-insensitive substring filter over title and Markdown content.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tag": {
      "description": "Filter to Notes carrying this tag label.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "includeSeed": {
      "description": "Include read-only Seed/Feed notes (default true when notebookId is specified, false otherwise).",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "limit": {
      "description": "Max notes to return (default 50).",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_note_get` (Tier 0 — note)
- **Title**: Get Note Details
- **Description**: Read a full Note by ID including authored Markdown, `sourceRevision`, parsed workout blocks, attached Session count, upstream provenance, and publication visibility.
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod note get <noteId> --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "noteId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Unique Note ID (UUID or seed route ID)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "noteId"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_note_upsert` (Tier 1 — note)
- **Title**: Create or Update Note
- **Description**: Create a new workout/reference Note or update an existing editable Note with full block-revision pinning, effort/equipment indexing, and optimistic concurrency (`expectedSourceRevision`).
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod note save <file|-> --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "noteId": {
      "description": "Existing Note ID to update, or omit to create a new Note.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "title": {
      "description": "Note title (defaults to # H1 heading in content).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Full Markdown document or Whiteboard Script body."
    },
    "sport": {
      "description": "Optional sport fence tag when passing bare Whiteboard Script.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "expectedSourceRevision": {
      "description": "Optimistic concurrency guard: pass the current sourceRevision from wod_note_get when updating.",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    },
    "notebookId": {
      "description": "Optional user Notebook ID/slug to link this Note into (always stays anchored in notebook/journal).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "journalDate": {
      "description": "Optional YYYY-MM-DD or \"today\" to place the Note on that Journal calendar day.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "content"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_note_clone` (Tier 1 — note)
- **Title**: Clone Note with Provenance
- **Description**: Clone any Note (especially read-only Seed or Feed workouts) into a writable user Notebook or Journal day while recording structured upstream `NoteProvenance`.
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod note clone <sourceNoteId> --notebook <slug> --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "sourceNoteId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Source Note ID (including read-only Seed/Feed Notes) to clone."
    },
    "targetNotebookId": {
      "description": "Target writable user Notebook ID/slug (defaults to \"notebook/journal\").",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "title": {
      "description": "Optional title override for the cloned Note.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "journalDate": {
      "description": "Optional YYYY-MM-DD or \"today\" to pin the clone onto a Journal day.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "sourceNoteId"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_note_delete` (Tier 2 — note)
- **Title**: Delete Note
- **Description**: Permanently delete a Note and detach its projections, tag links, and calendar placements (Tier 2 destructive — requires user confirmation or matching confirmId).
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod note delete <noteId> --yes <noteId> --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "noteId": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "ID of the Note to delete."
    },
    "confirmId": {
      "description": "For non-interactive MCP/CLI calls, repeat the exact noteId to confirm deletion.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "noteId"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_journal_day` (Tier 0 — journal)
- **Title**: Get Journal Day
- **Description**: Fetch all scheduled/authored workout Notes and recorded Sessions for a specific Journal calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `today`).
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod journal [today|YYYY-MM-DD] --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "date": {
      "description": "Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or \"today\" (defaults to \"today\").",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_journal_add` (Tier 1 — journal)
- **Title**: Add Workout to Journal Day
- **Description**: Create a new workout Note in `notebook/journal` and place it onto the specified calendar day (`YYYY-MM-DD` or `today`).
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod journal add <file|-> --date YYYY-MM-DD --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "date": {
      "description": "Target Journal date in YYYY-MM-DD format or \"today\" (defaults to \"today\").",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "title": {
      "description": "Workout title (defaults to # H1 heading or date).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "content": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "description": "Markdown workout note or bare Whiteboard Script to schedule onto the Journal day."
    },
    "sport": {
      "description": "Optional sport fence tag when passing bare Whiteboard Script.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "notebookId": {
      "description": "Optional additional user Notebook to promote this Journal Note into.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "content"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

```json
      "description": "Display name when creating or renaming a Notebook.",
      "type": "string"
    },

      "description": "Notebook description.",
      "type": "string"

      "description": "Notebook icon/emoji.",
      "type": "string"

      "description": "Note ID to promote into or detach from the Notebook.",

    },

        "type": "string"
```

### `wod_notebook_delete` (Tier 2 — notebook)

### `wod_session_run_headless` (Tier 1 — session)
- **Title**: Run Workout Session Headlessly
- **Description**: Execute a workout block through the headless JIT compiler and runtime state machine, recording a pinned `Session` and derived `EventRecord`s in storage. Automatically clones read-only Seed/Feed Notes into `notebook/journal`.
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod run <file|--note id> --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "noteId": {
      "description": "Existing Note ID to execute (read-only Seed/Feed Notes are automatically cloned to notebook/journal).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "blockId": {
      "description": "Optional workout block ID on `noteId` (defaults to first wod block).",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "source": {
      "description": "Inline Whiteboard Script or Markdown to persist & run when `noteId` is not supplied.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "title": {
      "description": "Optional Note title when running inline `source`.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "sport": {
      "description": "Optional sport dialect override.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "journalDate": {
      "description": "Optional YYYY-MM-DD or \"today\" Journal calendar date.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "collectibles": {
      "description": "Optional values for collectible `?` metrics (e.g. `{ \"lb\": 185, \"reps\": 12 }`).",
      "type": "object",
      "propertyNames": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "additionalProperties": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "number"
        ]
      }
    },
    "stepAdvanceMs": {
      "description": "Simulated clock advance per step in milliseconds (default 10000).",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 100,
      "maximum": 3600000
    },
    "maxSteps": {
      "description": "Safety cap on execution steps (default 500).",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 5000
    },
    "public": {
      "description": "Mark the recorded Session public for Feed publication.",
      "type": "boolean"
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### `wod_catalog_lookup` (Tier 0 — catalog)
- **Title**: Lookup Efforts, Equipment & Tags
- **Description**: Search or inspect the Effort movement registry, Equipment catalog, Tags, and Tag Categories with Notebook-scoped override precedence (`notebook/defaults` -> Feed/Notebook -> `notebook/custom`).
- **CLI Equivalent**: `wod catalog <efforts|equipment|tags> --json`
- **Input Schema**:
```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "effort",
        "equipment",
        "tag",
        "tag-type"
      ],
      "description": "Catalog family to search or inspect."
    },
    "search": {

      "maximum": 250
    }

    "kind"

  "additionalProperties": false
```

### `ui_clock_control` (Tier 1 — WebMCP UI)
- **Title**: Control Live Workout Clock

```json

        "dismiss",
        "status"
      ],

    },

      "description": "Target fieldId for entry-save, entry-skip, or choice-select.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "value": {
      "description": "Numeric value for entry-save or reps-set.",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "occurrenceId": {
      "description": "Rep occurrenceId for reps-adjust, reps-set, or reps-select.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "delta": {
      "description": "+1 or -1 delta for reps-adjust.",
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "type": "number",
          "const": 1
        },
        {
          "type": "number",
          "const": -1
        }
      ]
    },
    "index": {
      "description": "Zero-based alternative index for choice-select.",
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 9007199254740991
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "command"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

---

## MCP Resources & Templates

- `wod://schema/whiteboard-script` (text/markdown) — Compact syntax, metric token, and fence-tag guide for authoring Whiteboard Language workouts.
- `wod://schema/wql` (application/json) — Machine-readable WQL targets, aggregators, filter keys, metric families, and examples.
- `wod://notebooks` (application/json) — Current local and subscribed feed notebooks with member counts.
- `wod://note/{noteId}` (application/json) — Full Markdown source, block map, tags, and recent sessions for a Note.
- `wod://journal/{date}` (application/json) — Scheduled notes and logged sessions for YYYY-MM-DD or today.
- `wod://session/{sessionId}` (application/json) — Session record and full segment/summary event ledger.

## MCP Prompts

- `encode-workout`: Convert unstructured workout text into valid ```wod Markdown and verify with wod_parse_script.
- `analyze-training-load`: Inspect recent sessions, volume rollups, and movement balance over a date window.
- `program-journal-day`: Review recent training history, avoid movement interference, and schedule a workout on a date.
